description: Search seasons by ID or year. Returns each season with its name, start and end dates, status and number of tournaments. Seasons from 2023 onwards are available.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results, or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

year.description: Year of the season to filter by (2023 onwards).

name: search-seasons
